dragscroll.modmenu.description: Enables scrolling menus and lists by holding left mouse button and dragging. Designed for mobile Java Minecraft launchers.
dragscroll.config.title: Allow mobile scroll Settings
dragscroll.config.threshold.label: Threshold
dragscroll.config.threshold.description: Scroll start threshold in pixels. Range: 1-50. Default: 4. Higher values delay recognizing a touch as a scroll.
dragscroll.config.inertia.label: Inertia strength
dragscroll.config.inertia.description: Inertia strength. Default: 70. Range: from 0 to 200.
dragscroll.config.debug.description: ⚠ Caution: enabling this will write a very large amount of mouse/touch data to the log. Enable only for debugging so we can look at the log and fix a bug. It is not needed for normal use.
dragscroll.config.enabled.description: OFF gives the game back its own (vanilla) input. After a restart no part of the mod is loaded into the game. If the mod crashes the game or keeps failing, it switches itself off the same way. Emergency switch without opening the game: create the file config/allowmobilescroll.disable.
dragscroll.config.enabled.safemode: Safe mode is on now: %s. Switching the mod ON takes effect after a restart.
dragscroll.config.merchant_bar.descripti: Makes the villager trading screen's scrollbar 2× wider (to the right) for easier grabbing on touch screens.
dragscroll.config.wheel_block_creative.d: Fixes the bug with visual scrolling of inventory textures, but fully disables the mouse-wheel emulator in the creative inventory. You can still scroll the item list with the scrollbar.
dragscroll.config.wheel_invert.descripti: Inverts the vertical direction of the on-screen mouse-wheel emulator.
dragscroll.config.wheel_setup.descriptio: Configure the mouse-wheel emulator. The key to open it defaults to Numpad_divide (changeable in Minecraft's Controls). On scroll lists that this mod does not support yet, you can point at the area, turn the emulator on, and use the virtual wheel. If it does not work, try tapping the area first.
dragscroll.wheel.setup.title: Mouse wheel emulator setup
dragscroll.safemode.toast.title: Allow mobile scroll: safe mode
dragscroll.safemode.toast.body: Vanilla input. Turn the mod on in its settings
